clips.title: The story
paras: This errand serves as a vital courier mission linking the Royal Apothecary Society's research in Brill with their ongoing efforts in Silverpine Forest. Tasked by Apothecary Johaan, you carry valuable findings to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to aid the development of the Dark Lady's New Plague.

The Royal Apothecary Society operates under the direct command of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, tasked with concocting a New Plague capable of wiping out both the living and the Scourge. Isolated laboratories across Forsaken territory cannot work in a vacuum; survival and progress demand constant communication. In Brill, Apothecary Johaan has gathered experimental results that must be circulated to other researchers in the field without delay.

Silverpine Forest represents the next frontier of Forsaken expansion and research. Based out of the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel oversees biochemical testing amidst regional threats like the Moonrage worgen, rogue humans, and lingering Scourge. By receiving Johaan's notes from Tirisfal Glades, Renferrel integrates new alchemical findings into his own local experiments, further advancing the Society's grand design.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas. Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.
Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Follow the roads to the south from Brill. From the Undercity go southwest.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What business do you have with me, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research. With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades. Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.
But you must excuse my rambling. Extend your stay in Silverpine, friend. We could use an able bodied adventurer like you around here.
